name: New Year's Nyan Cat
description:
Nyan Cat celebrates the end of the year flying through a dazzling fireworks filled sky. It's a time to raise a toast to loved ones, both here and gone, and to look forward to a brighter, better future.  Should auld acquaintance be forgot and never brought to mind? Of course not, which is why this special piece was originally granted to holders who have believed in me through my journey in this space.

Owning this NFT grants the following stats:

Appreciation + 100

Prosperity + 150

Bubbly +1000
